what_is_not_a_bath: Split foyers with 2 baths above grade also include a $52,000 finished-lower-level premium. Townhouses with 2 baths include a $20,000 end-unit premium, and in this file every 2-story townhouse has 1 bath and every 3-story townhouse has 2 baths. Those extras are not in any column. A hinge on full baths can pick them up.
